question: Should the receipt API land as a standalone ledger layer after the two prerequisite PRs, or be folded into the cloud-intake consumer once the full stack has live proof?
rationale: The patch appears internally coherent, but its permanent API and stored-event contract span multiple unmerged branches, so automation cannot safely choose the integration and upgrade boundary.

options.title: Land After Prerequisites
options.body: Keep this PR separate, rebase it after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/554 land, and require representative ledger replay proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Consumer
options.body: Combine the receipt API with https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/563 so the durable contract and its first production consumer receive one integration review.

options.title: Pause Durable Receipts
options.body: Keep observations ephemeral until maintainers confirm that durable digest receipts justify expanding the action-ledger contract.

recommendation.title: Land After Prerequisites
recommendation.body: Keep this PR separate, rebase it after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/554 land, and require representative ledger replay proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the coordinated Gitcrawl stack and are best positioned to explain the intended contract and landing order.
